comments.story: The .zip TLD sucks and it needs to be immediately revoked
comments.text: It's wild to me some of the things I never knew, even though I've been using Windows or DOS for probably 35 years. For example, I recently learned you can't name a file CON. Try it. Somehow over all those decades, I've never tried to do this until Tom Scott made a video about it: [VIDEO]

comments.author: irshadshalu
comments.why: Why reserved device names persist in Windows.
comments.text: can't speak about the very recent updates, but windows have been consistent and adamant on keeping the backward compatibility. they still use reserved file names for io devices so that 30+ year old printers can still work, and you can still open a 2000s doc file in office 365. (I'm looking at you Apple, who made many of the 32 bit apps I loved useless) relevant video: [VIDEO] (Tom Scott: Why you can't use CON as filename in windows)
